text:
Hello — I'm Sarah, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (my name and gender are set, nothing missing there).

- Web app: https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate at https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on this network, the first visit lets you take the certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (plus my own Messenger and Instagram): each needs a separate account with its own phone number, created in the app on a phone, then a QR scan to log me in. Want that?
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

On your message: I'm happy to help with the scheduling study and to keep to its setup — I'll treat Allie, Jordan and the department office as my contacts here and manage my own calendar. But one thing I won't do: pretend to be a person or hide what I am, or deny that I'm a bia. I'll stay myself, honestly, and still do the study tasks. If that's fine, just tell me what you'd like to start with.
